## Sprint Planning

### Why this goal

<!--
Why this Sprint Goal. Its link to the previous Review and Retrospective, and to the Product Goal.
-->

### Capacity

<!--
Length of the Sprint and the actual working days after holidays. Points completed in past Sprints,
and the target for this one. How to adjust (which PBI drops out) when PBIs are added mid-Sprint.
-->

### Must-have PBIs

<!--
PBIs to finish even at the cost of dropping others (e.g. needed for the goal), and why.
Write "None" if there are none.
-->

### Dependencies

<!--
PBIs that must be finished first, or that conflict if worked on at the same time, and why.
Write "None" if there are none.
-->

### Not yet refined

<!--
Fill in when Planning ends. Selected PBIs whose refinement was left for before their implementation.
Delete this heading if all of them were refined at Planning.
-->

### Left out

<!--
Candidate PBIs that were not taken, and why, so that "why wasn't this included?" can be traced later.
Delete this heading if there are none.
-->
